text: It is because you can not have two “visas” at the same time so you can’t be here as a tourist and also going through the partner visa. When October 7th happened I had been waiting for a year for my interview, I was not allowed to come into the country and visit my partner who was in miluim. I had no idea when I would see him. Thankfully the following January they allowed me to come for the interview. It can be heartbreaking but the law is the law. For reference I am also with a European passport (Sweden). So waiting now 3 months is not only normal it’s actually faster than the normal process for a lot of people and it means she needs to stay out of Israel until the interview. Good luck 👍
